why_relevant: Runs occasional country deep-dives on Slovenia's fintech scene that name founders, executives and employers — a pointer to the actor map for A5 hiring/leadership tracking even though it is not a people-moves column.
Niche commercial-payments community that indexed Slovenian processor news (Bankart/Nets) in English; archives items after original vendor pages rotate, matching this cell's archival rationale.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters - On The Move
why_relevant: A genuine, dedicated CEE people-moves column ('Latest CEE Senior Legal Moves and Appointments') that includes Slovenian in-house and advisory hires at banks; structured, paginated and archived, so it is a high-precision retrieval channel for compliance/legal leadership moves.
Sister publication focused on in-house counsel and compliance roles across CEE, including Slovenian banks; complements the On The Move column with interviews that reveal org-structure changes.

source_name: Central Banking - Bank of Slovenia organisation page
source_subtype: specialist regulator trade press, entity index page
why_relevant: Specialist central-banking trade press keeps a per-institution page aggregating Banka Slovenije news including governor/deputy-governor appointments and departures — a clean, entity-scoped English index for regulator org changes.

US-based payments outlet with EU-level tag pages (EPC, SEPA, instant payments) that occasionally name Slovenian participants and executives in pan-European bodies; useful for catching SI representatives appointed to EU payments committees.

source_name: European Payments Council - news and organisation pages
source_subtype: EU industry body newsletter + governance pages
why_relevant: EU-level payments body publishing newsletters, working-group and board composition; Slovenian PSP/bank representatives appointed to EPC bodies appear here in English and nowhere in local media. Also names its own leadership (e.g. Director General Giorgio Andreoli).

NLB's English investor-relations stream is the canonical English record of management- and supervisory-board appointments at Slovenia's largest bank and the item aggregators like SeeNews translate; also covers subsidiary and Bankart-related org changes.

Pan-CEE English outlet covering banking, fintech and talent themes; low people-move density for Slovenia but publishes ecosystem/intelligence pieces that surface employer names and hiring trends useful to A5 actor mapping.

Global wire that covers Slovenian central-bank appointment politics in English, sometimes ahead of local confirmation (e.g. the Rop nomination story); valuable as an early-signal channel for regulator leadership.

source_subtype: social push channel of a news agency
why_relevant: Push channel for STA English headlines; a cheap low-latency pointer that surfaces appointment items minutes after publication and links back to english.sta.si permalinks.
Not a people-move source, but an English-language structured index of Slovenian banks and licensed TPPs/PSPs — the actor list against which appointment searches in this cell should be run.

source_name: NLB Group – Prosta delovna mesta (career portal)
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian banking group; vacancy list filterable by category (Business support, Sales, Sales support) and location (Ljubljana, Domzale, Koper...). IT/payments/cards role titles reveal projects, vendor stack and org units months before press releases. Group-level page also exposes hiring in NLB subsidiaries across SEE.

Underlying ATS behind NLB's careers pages. ATS career sites usually expose stable, near-structured job records (id, title, org unit, location, posting date) that are far easier to diff over time than the CMS front-end. Identifying the ATS vendor (Cornerstone OnDemand) is itself HR-tech vendor intelligence about NLB.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (ex-Nova KBM + ex-SKB) – Kariera
why_relevant: Second-largest Slovenian bank after the Nova KBM / SKB consolidation into OTP banka; ~2,500 staff. Post-merger hiring is a strong signal of core-banking / card / channel migration projects. Page also documents the full hiring workflow (e-form, psych testing, medical) which sets collection cadence expectations.

source_name: OTP banka job board on FledgeHR ATS
why_relevant: The actual vacancy list for OTP banka Slovenia sits on FledgeHR, a Slovenian/regional ATS. Gives per-role detail (unit, location, requirements) that names internal departments. FledgeHR is likely shared by other SI employers, so learning its URL scheme unlocks a whole family of career feeds.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenija – Zaposlujemo / prosta delovna mesta
why_relevant: Ex-Banka Koper, third/fourth-largest SI bank. Local careers page routes to the group ATS; publishes contact kadri@intesasanpaolobank.si and an open-application form. Local page carries Slovenian job titles that the group portal sometimes anglicises.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo group careers portal – Slovenia category (SAP SuccessFactors)
why_relevant: Confirmed live Slovenia job category on the group's SuccessFactors ATS: at time of scouting it listed 9 SI roles including a 'Digital Channels Specialist' (Koper/Ljubljana) alongside branch advisor roles in Koper, Ajdovscina, Logatec, Postojna. Function taxonomy ('Digital, Tech & Data Management') makes IT/payments hiring directly filterable — an exemplary weak-signal feed for this cell.

Self-hosted vacancy list (no third-party ATS) with dated postings — easiest bank in scope to diff reliably. At time of scouting it carried ~9 roles including 'Windows systems engineer', 'RDARR validation specialist', 'Security and safety manager', contact-centre and banking-operations support — i.e. direct evidence of a risk-data (BCBS239/RDARR) programme and an in-house infrastructure team. AIK-group owned, so hiring also signals regional group strategy.

Fastest-growing SI savings bank. At scouting it advertised 'Strokovni sodelavec v sektorju placilnih sistemov' (payment systems sector specialist) and a 'Data governance specialist' — a textbook weak signal naming an internal payments-systems SECTOR and a data-governance build-out. Dated postings; applications by email to kadrovska@dh.si (no ATS).

Universal bank with ~76 branches (third-densest SI branch network) — its advisor/branch vacancies are the best available proxy for branch-network staffing and regional expansion. At scouting ~12 open roles including 'placilni promet' (payment operations) specialist, credit-risk specialist, cash-operations associate, and a regional director for Dolenjska (a leadership move).

source_name: Addiko Bank d.d. Ljubljana – Prosta delovna mesta
why_relevant: Consumer/SME-focused digital-leaning bank and an active M&A target (NLB bid for Addiko). Vacancy volume and role mix here is a leading indicator of both its digital-channel roadmap and of integration/retention dynamics under ownership uncertainty. Publishes recruitment workflow and contact zaposlitev.si@addiko.com; states roles are pushed to job portals and social media.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. – Zaposlovanje (Erste Group careers portal)
source_subtype: bank career page + group ATS entity feed
why_relevant: Slovenian arm of Erste/Steiermärkische. Careers page states applications run EXCLUSIVELY through the Erste Group careers portal, so the group ATS is the authoritative feed and the SI-only page is a pointer. Erste's portal exposes a per-entity category (bankasparkasse) that can be polled for SI roles.

source_name: Erste Group careers portal – Banka Sparkasse entity category
why_relevant: The authoritative vacancy feed for Banka Sparkasse SI, hosted on Erste's group ATS. Entity-scoped category ID makes SI roles isolable from the wider Erste footprint; job pages should carry stable IDs for diffing.

Dedicated careers subdomain for UniCredit's Slovenian bank — subdomain-level separation suggests a distinct, pollable job app rather than CMS pages. UniCredit SI is a notable corporate/payments player, so its IT and transaction-banking hiring is high-value.

source_name: BKS Bank AG, bancna podruznica Slovenija – Kariera
why_relevant: Austrian bank's Slovenian branch. Career section explicitly routes applications through the MojeDelo portal (kariera@bksbank.si as contact) — a documented example of the 'bank uses MojeDelo instead of an ATS' pattern this cell must cover. Small headcount means each vacancy is proportionally more informative.

source_name: Primorska hranilnica Vipava – Zaposlujemo / Aktualna delovna mesta
why_relevant: Small regional savings bank; its careers page explicitly states vacancies are published regularly on Mojedelo.com, with an on-site open-application route. Confirms the MojeDelo-as-de-facto-ATS pattern for the savings-bank tier and gives a concrete company profile to snowball.
